_note: Single source of truth for the basket. Terraform reads this file and feeds it to both the ingestion Lambda's environment and the Athena partition-projection enum, so the two can never drift apart. Do not hardcode a symbol list anywhere else.
_active_note: Slice 1-4 run BTCUSDT-only on purpose: one symbol makes dedup and window-function output small enough to verify by eye. Expanded at slice 5.

_undecided.reason: Both return HTTP 200 from the klines endpoint, but HTTP 200 only proves the symbol is KNOWN to the exchange, not that it is actively trading. Needs a bar-freshness check before either is admitted. Including a symbol that returns stale bars would poison the freshness DQ check and produce a permanently-flatlined series in the anomaly detector.
